data_fields.name: blocker_grace
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 s = TICKS_PER_SECOND*4, set when the blocker count is released

data_fields.name: win_grace
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 s, or 3 s in v1.07 mode (TICKS_PER_SECOND*1 / *3)

data_fields.name: lose_grace
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 s, or 3 s in v1.07 mode (TICKS_PER_SECOND*1 / *3)

data_fields.name: blocker_count
data_fields.donor_constant: count of ALLOWWIN triggers attached to the house; win applies only at zero

data_fields.name: threshold_data
data_fields.donor_constant: credits and count events fire when data >= threshold

best_idea: A win is a pending flag that waits for a blocker count to reach zero and a grace countdown to run out before it is applied once, and each trigger is one-shot, counted over several holders, or permanent.
decision_why: Keep the pending flag, blocker count and grace; fix the donor's shared countdown (a blocker removal resets a running countdown to 4 s) by starting the blocker countdown only when the last blocker goes; route the outcome through the one server ledger.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a zone clear is not applied while one blocker is alive, that the outcome applies once after the grace counted from the last blocker, and that a second blocker removal during a running countdown does not extend it.
